fixes_applied: §1.1/§1.2/TL;DR#1,#3: removed false 'reward from RM vs from environment' strict binary between RLHF and Agentic RL; reframed as differing in credit-assignment timescale + verification mode; noted Agentic RL can also use a learned RM (WebRL's ORM)

§7.3 PPO value-loss code comment + new note: 'observation V has no meaning' overstated — V(s_t) is conceptually meaningful at the state boundary (GAE bootstrap anchor); agent-token-only value loss is an engineering simplification, not a claim of meaninglessness (NEEDS_NUANCE)
§4.2 + Q15: sparse-reward GAE special-case formula corrected to the full λ-dependent telescoping form; A_t = γ^(T-t)R − V(s_t) only holds exactly at λ=1, previously stated as if general

Q22 item 2: GRPO trace-level advantage re-described as biased-but-consistent (not 'unbiased MC return'), enumerating the (1-1/G) self-inclusion shrinkage, std-normalization bias, and PPO-clip bias sources
Q9: 'clamp σ lower bound keeps a small signal' corrected — numerator is exactly 0 in an all-identical group regardless of denominator clamp; clamp only prevents 0/0 NaN, does not restore signal

Q18 + §7.x: per-step KL vs trajectory KL reframed — same quantity in expectation by the chain rule (Σ log π(a_t|s_t)), differ only in shaping/aggregation/estimator implementation, not in what they measure (NEEDS_NUANCE)
